technical_quality: Diagnostic quality. Adequate inspiration (~9 posterior ribs), no significant rotation (clavicles roughly symmetric about the spinous processes), adequate penetration (vertebral bodies faintly visible through the heart). Apices and both costophrenic angles included; both lung bases and the right costophrenic angle are partially obscured by large breast shadows.

devices.type: External radiographic marker / technologist marker (small lettered marker, reads approximately 'L'/'MM')
devices.location: Image top-right corner, i.e. patient's left upper side, outside the thorax; no lines, tubes, clips, or pacemaker present

abnormalities.finding: Large, well-circumscribed, round, homogeneous pulmonary mass approximately 9 cm in diameter, lateral to the right hilum and abutting the lateral chest wall; lung markings are visible below it, so it is separate from the hemidiaphragm; no cavitation or calcification evident. (This is the labelled finding.)
abnormalities.zone: middle, extending into the upper part of the lower zone (approx. 3rd-5th anterior rib levels)

abnormalities.finding: Tortuous / unfolded thoracic aorta with a prominent aortic knob, consistent with age-related change; cardiothoracic ratio within normal limits
Large bilateral breast shadows partially obscuring the lower zones (normal soft tissue, not pathological - noted to avoid misinterpretation as basal opacity)

description_zh: PA 正面胸部X光，吸氣量足夠，無明顯旋轉。右側中肺野（並延伸至下肺野上部）可見一約 9 公分、邊緣清楚的圓形均質腫塊影，位於右肺門外側並貼近側胸壁，其下方仍可見肺紋理，與右側橫膈分離，未見明顯空洞或鈣化。心臟大小正常，胸主動脈迂曲、主動脈弓突出，符合年齡相關變化；左肺野清晰，未見肋膜積液或氣胸，左側橫膈下可見正常胃泡。無任何置入性管線、引流管或裝置，僅見影像右上角之外部標記；雙側乳房陰影部分遮蔽兩下肺野。
